beats.say: A QR code is just a link you cannot read with your eyes.
Most phone cameras show the web address before opening it, so pause and read it.
Scammers sometimes stick fake codes over real ones on posters and parking meters.
If a code asks for payment or a password, go to the official site yourself instead.
Never scan a code that arrives in an unexpected message asking you to act fast.
Read the link before you tap today, and send this to someone who scans everything.
